title: Tail-Influence Sampling for CVaR Policy Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2609.38096v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Policies with similar mean returns can differ sharply in rare failures, yet estimating lower-tail conditional value-at-risk (CVaR) accurately can require many costly rollouts. When different conditional components of a stochastic workflow can be queried separately, we ask how to allocate a fixed evaluation budget to estimate a fixed policy's CVaR most accurately. We derive a tail influence for each queryable conditional law that aggregates how its uncertainty affects CVaR across every Bellman reuse. Its variance yields the fixed-design efficiency bound and the oracle Neyman allocation. Tail-Influence Sampling (TIS) estimates these influence scales from a pilot model and reallocates fresh queries toward kernels that matter most for the tail; a visitation-anchored variant protects against pilot underallocation. translated_title: 用于CVaR策略评估的尾部影响采样
translated_abstract: 平均回报相近的策略在罕见失败情形下可能表现出巨大差异，然而准确估计下尾条件风险价值（CVaR）往往需要大量代价高昂的模拟采样（rollout）。当随机工作流中不同的条件组成部分可以被分别查询时，我们研究如何在固定的评估预算下，最准确地估计一个固定策略的CVaR。我们为每个可查询的条件分布推导出一种“尾部影响”度量，它汇总了该分布的不确定性在每一次Bellman重用中对CVaR的影响。其方差给出了固定设计下的效率界以及oracle Neyman最优分配。尾部影响采样从先导模型中估计这些影响尺度，并将新的查询重新分配到对尾部最关键的核上；一种以访问分布为锚点的变体可以防止先导模型导致的分配不足。在固定维度和正分位数裕度的条件下，TIS达到了oracle渐近方差，并在计入先导成本的情况下取得一阶MSE（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出尾部影响采样（TIS）方法，通过量化各可查询条件分布对CVaR估计的尾部影响并据此最优分配评估预算，实现了oracle级别的渐近方差效率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Tail-Influence Sampling (TIS), which optimally allocates a fixed evaluation budget by quantifying each queryable conditional distribution's tail influence on CVaR estimation, achieving oracle-level asymptotic variance efficiency.
